findings.title: Untrusted web content can reach shell execution
findings.fix: Separate browser-facing agents from shell tools or require explicit approval.

findings.title: Secrets reachable from browser-facing agent context
findings.fix: Move secrets outside agent-readable paths and split credentialed workflows.

findings.title: Repository writes sit near deployment workflow
findings.fix: Require human review for agent-authored commits and separate deploy credentials.
